calls.reason: The 'always will be' claim has no deadline. SimpleQA Verified measures recall, not fact-checking, and SelfCheckGPT shows some sampling-based detection, so the evidence is mixed and adjacent.
Everything in the packet favours GPT-5's prose: a blinded study rating its academic writing above GPT-4, a matched Tom's Guide writing test and OpenAI's launch claims. Nothing points the other way.
OpenAI introduced GPT-5 in August 2025, and its Q4 2023 launch was GPT-4 Turbo. GPT-5 could not have transformed the world in Q4 2023, and the Q* report was unverified.
The starship deadline has passed, but the fusion and nanotech parts are undated. The GPT-5 fusion case study shows useful help, not a revolution, so the main claim stays open.
The prediction has no deadline. The military benchmark study and the GPT-5 launch notice neither show nor rule out GPT-5 giving anyone starships or an insuperable military advantage.
Microsoft's 2023 GPT-4 demonstrations show creative combination, but there was no independent check of whether the ideas were new. Nothing shows the outputs were mere copies either.
